message: So, we had a little blackout recently, and let me tell you, trying to find a flashlight in the dark is like a comedy skit gone wrong. Who knew my living room could transform into an obstacle course? I stumbled upon this handy guide from the Red Cross that lays out some smart ways to prepare for power outages. Trust me, being ready is way more fun than fumbling around for candles! What's your favorite way to pass the time when the lights go out?
